name: 38726-longprefill-8b-pp4
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), ONE node, no host-to-host fabric, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: PP=4, TP=1, DP=1, `mp` distributed executor, V1 engine core, one in-process vLLM engine, asynchronous scheduling on. PP=4 is the declared topology: at PP=1 there is no pipeline and the setup asks a different question.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM dense: 36 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.2B params (~16.4 GB). 36 layers over 4 stages is an even 9 per GPU, so VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION is unset.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 16 streams, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown by request count, bounded at 200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap (a runaway guard, not a bound). Only the warmup fires: guidellm sizes the cooldown off `safety_seconds` and it never opens on a run this short, so the scored population is ~180 requests, not 160.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 32768 prompt tokens and 1 output token, FIXED (min = max = mean, so every request is identical) and no prefix buckets. Prefill-dominated by construction: at the 8192-token per-step budget each prompt is exactly four chunks. `request_format: plain` so the prompt goes to the engine as a completion rather than through a chat template; vLLM tokenizes with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine's own count may differ from 32768 by a token or two. The backend sets ignore_eos, so the single output token is always produced. Temperature 0.0.
purpose: A document analysis service ingesting 32,000-token reports on an 8B model, 16 concurrent streams across four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
pipeline-parallel-size: 4
tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: mp
async-scheduling: true
enable-chunked-prefill: true
# PINNED: 8192 is the per-step token budget the 32768-token prompts in scenario.json are sized
# against -- raising it changes how many chunks a prompt spans and dissolves the workload.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 40960
max-num-seqs: 16
# LOAD-BEARING: with reuse on, a repeated synthetic prompt head would be served from cache and
# the prefill this setup is built around would partly stop happening.
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
